title: The Shed Scales
text: Scales the quarry has shed lie scattered along its path, each the size of a hand and sharp as a knife at the edge. They glitter in the mud like coins. Some have blood on them. Not the quarry's.

options.label: Gather the sharp scales, and mind your fingers.

outcomes.text: Good for armor, and every hand cut gathering them.

options.label: Follow the trail of scales while the quarry is molting and weak.

outcomes.text: To the quarry, molting and weak, and too slow to run.

options.label: The wisest studies the scales, to learn where it is thin.

outcomes.text: Its weak point, under the left wing, where the scales grow thin.
